metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAM Multiaxis Per-Op Tab Deep Pass — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections + BLADE_5AX + MULTI_AXIS_POCKET
metadata.description: Deep-pass extension to multiaxis-operations.json (MS0/U-CAM23). Closes the input-exhaust gap by adding the 5 standard deep tabs (Strategy, Ramp, Holder, Output, Connections) to the 7 existing multiaxis ops. The 5 simpler ops (flow, morphed_spiral_multiaxis, rotary_4axis, trimming, impeller_machining) also get Heights + Linking tabs that the parent catalog omitted. Two net-new ops added: BLADE_5AX (turbine-blade-specific 5-axis finishing with leading/trailing-edge blend strategy) and MULTI_AXIS_POCKET (5-axis adaptive pocket roughing with tilt-to-avoid). Together brings Fusion 360 multiaxis to 100% input-field coverage per L2-CAMX-EXHAUST mandate.
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help — Multiaxis reference (Swarf / Multi-Axis Contour / Flow / Rotary / Morphed Spiral Multiaxis / Trimming / Impeller Machining / Blade Machining / Multi-Axis Pocket) + Manufacturing Extension 5-axis tilt envelope reference + Mazak Variaxis / DMG MORI DMU programming guide + ISO 10303-238 STEP-NC AP238 multiaxis supplement + post.cps Manual NC reference + Holder Collision Check + Tool Axis tilt strategies

commonTabs.description: New tabs added by the deep pass on top of existing base (tool/geometry/passes/tool_orientation/collision; some ops have heights/linking, some don't). The deep pass adds Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections to all ops, and fills Heights/Linking where parent catalog omitted them.

SWARF_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to swarf — flank-driven 5-axis finishing for tapered walls, fan blades, ruled surfaces. Adds Strategy (tangent gap / drive surface flip), Ramp (helical lead-in along ruled surface), Holder (5-axis tilt envelope), Output (NURBS spline output), Connections (tool-axis-change cost-aware stay-down).

parameters.name: Tangent Gap Tolerance
parameters.description: Max gap to flank surface when flank-driving

parameters.name: Drive Surface Flip
parameters.description: Reverse drive-surface orientation (for outside vs inside flanks)

parameters.name: Maximum Tilt Angle
parameters.description: Max tool-axis tilt to clear holder (5-axis Mfg Ext)

parameters.name: Use RTCP
parameters.description: Output Runtime Tool Center Point (G43.4 / TRAORI)

parameters.name: Tool Axis Change Cost
parameters.description: Penalty weight for tool-axis discontinuities (higher = prefer continuous orientation)

MULTI_AXIS_CONTOUR_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to multi_axis_contour — curve-driven 5-axis finishing along selected edges/curves. Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections.

FLOW_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to flow — surface-flow finishing along U/V parametric directions. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

MORPHED_SPIRAL_MULTIAXIS_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to morphed_spiral_multiaxis — boundary-following spiral on 5-axis surfaces. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

ROTARY_4AXIS_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to rotary_4axis — 4-axis indexed/continuous rotary milling around an axis. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

parameters.name: Clearance Diameter
parameters.description: Clearance OD around rotary axis

parameters.name: Stay Down Angle

parameters.name: C-Axis Continuous
parameters.description: Continuous C-axis rotation vs index-and-cut

parameters.name: Maximum C-Axis Rate
parameters.description: Rotary feed rate cap

parameters.name: Use RTCP
parameters.description: Output RTCP-aware moves (G43.4)

TRIMMING_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to trimming — 5-axis edge-trimming for sheet/composite parts. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

parameters.name: Trim Edge Offset
parameters.description: Tool offset along the edge normal

IMPELLER_MACHINING_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to impeller_machining — specialized 5-axis impeller / blisk roughing+finishing with hub/shroud collision modeling. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

parameters.description: Inner-radius hub surface

parameters.name: Shroud Surface

parameters.name: Inlet Plane
parameters.description: Flow-inlet plane

parameters.name: Outlet Plane
parameters.description: Flow-outlet plane

parameters.description: Auto-detected from geometry, override if needed

BLADE_5AX.description: Net-new turbine-blade-specific 5-axis finishing op. Specialized for compressor/turbine blade leading-edge / pressure-side / suction-side / trailing-edge with continuous-flank tool-axis control and leading-edge blend strategy. Missing entirely from MS0/U-CAM23 catalog (Fusion's Manufacturing Extension exposes Blade as a distinct strategy from Impeller).

parameters.name: Tool
parameters.description: Ball / barrel / circle-segment recommended

parameters.name: Tilt Smoothing
parameters.description: Smooth tool-axis transitions across leading edge

parameters.name: Leading Edge Blend Width
parameters.description: Arc length over which to blend leading-edge tool axis

MULTI_AXIS_POCKET.description: Net-new 5-axis pocket roughing op — adaptive clearing with 5-axis tilt-to-avoid for deep undercut pockets, draft-walled cavities, and reach-limited regions where 3-axis tools would collide. Missing entirely from MS0/U-CAM23 catalog.

parameters.name: Optimal Load
parameters.description: Target radial engagement (woc)
